hotspots.title: SFC Farmers' Market · Downtown
hotspots.subtitle: Republic Square · 75+ farm, food, and craft vendors

info.description: Sustainable Food Center's flagship downtown farmers market at Republic Square. Year-round on Saturdays, with prepared food, produce, and artisan vendors.

hotspots.title: Texas Farmers' Market at Mueller (Sun)
hotspots.subtitle: Browning Hangar · producer-only farm + artisan market

info.description: Year-round producer-only farmers market at the Browning Hangar in Mueller. Sundays draw a heavy neighborhood and regional crowd.

hotspots.title: Texas Farmers' Market at Mueller (Wed)
hotspots.subtitle: Browning Hangar · weeknight evening farmers market

info.description: Midweek-evening edition of the Mueller farmers market — same producers, more food trucks and dinner-and-shop crowd.

hotspots.title: Texas Farmers' Market at Lakeline
hotspots.subtitle: Lakeline Mall · northwest suburban farm + maker market

info.description: Texas Farmers' Market's northwest outpost in the Lakeline Mall parking lot. Saturday-morning year-round farmers and artisans.

hotspots.title: HOPE Farmers Market
hotspots.subtitle: Plaza Saltillo · east-side Sunday farmers + craft market

info.description: East-side Sunday market at Plaza Saltillo, rain or shine year-round. Local farms, prepared food, live music, and craft vendors.

hotspots.title: Barton Creek Farmers Market
hotspots.subtitle: Barton Creek Square · Austin's original farmers market

info.description: Widely cited as Austin's original farmers market. Saturdays in the Barton Creek Square mall parking area with farm produce, prepared food, and crafts.

hotspots.title: Domain Farmers Market
hotspots.subtitle: Domain North Austin · neighborhood farmers + artisan market

info.description: Neighborhood farmers market in the Domain, typically near the IPIC theater plaza. Functions as a popup vendor layer inside North Austin's largest mixed-use development. Confirm exact day and location with the organizer before visiting.

hotspots.title: Boggy Creek Farm Farmstand
hotspots.subtitle: 3414 Lyons Rd · East Austin urban farm stand

info.description: East Austin urban farm running a multi-day-per-week farmstand at the farm itself. Wednesday through Saturday mornings with produce and eggs straight from the field.

hotspots.title: SoCo Makers Market
hotspots.subtitle: 1500 S Congress Ave · handmade, vintage, and art stalls

info.description: Outdoor handmade-goods market on South Congress with a curated lineup of local makers. Open Friday through Sunday year-round.

hotspots.title: Guad Vintage Market
hotspots.subtitle: 2932 Guadalupe St · Sunday vintage market on the Drag

info.description: Weekly vintage clothing and goods market outside Pavement Modern & Recycled on the Drag near UT. Rotating dealers every Sunday afternoon.

hotspots.title: Uncommon Flea
hotspots.subtitle: Behind Uncommon Objects on Fortview Rd · monthly curated flea

info.description: Curated monthly flea market in the parking lot and yard behind Uncommon Objects in South Austin. Held the last Sunday of every month, 10am–3pm — check Instagram (@uncommonflea) before driving over.

hotspots.title: City-Wide Vintage Sale
hotspots.subtitle: Palmer Events Center · large indoor vintage market

info.description: Indoor vintage market at Palmer Events Center drawing sellers from across Texas. Runs select weekends roughly monthly — 2026 dates include May 23–24, Jun 20–21, Jul 18–19, Aug 15–16, Sep 26–27, and Dec 5–6. Check citywidevintagesale.com before going.

hotspots.title: Eastside Pop-Up @ Central Machine Works
hotspots.subtitle: 4824 E Cesar Chavez · brewery-yard makers market

info.description: Recurring makers pop-up in the Central Machine Works brewery yard. Cadence varies — verify the next date on the brewery's calendar before visiting.

hotspots.title: Blue Genie Art Bazaar
hotspots.subtitle: 6100 Airport Blvd · seasonal handmade art bazaar

info.description: Curated indoor art bazaar with 200+ local artists. Seasonal — runs roughly Nov 21 through Dec 24 each year (with a shorter spring pop-up some years). Check bluegenieartbazaar.com for current dates.

hotspots.title: Cherrywood Art Fair
hotspots.subtitle: Maplewood Elementary · annual east-side art fair

info.description: Annual neighborhood art fair held one weekend in early December at Maplewood Elementary. Local artists, makers, food, and live music. Check cherrywoodartfair.org for the exact dates.

hotspots.title: Renegade Craft Austin
hotspots.subtitle: Fair Market, 1100 E 5th St · juried indie craft fair

info.description: National juried indie craft fair that visits Austin roughly twice a year (spring + holiday). Recent editions have been at Fair Market on East 5th. Check renegadecraft.com for the next Austin date.
